sections.heading: Certification and Landowner Consent
text: Certification. The Applicant, acting through its Program Administrator, submits this application for the parcel described above and certifies that, to the best of its knowledge after reasonable inquiry, the information in this application and its tabs is accurate and complete as of the date of application.

Landowner consent. Clearwater Land LLC, as owner of record, consents to the filing of this application for the Property described in Tab 2 and confirms that it has granted the option to purchase described in Tab 5. The landowner makes no other representation in this application.

content.signature_intro: Signed by the Applicant's authorized representative and by the landowner of record.

exhibits.title: Tab 3 — Klamath County Filings (Record Extract)
text: Extract prepared from the Klamath County filings obtained by Cascade Timber Holdings Land Records at Alder's request of March 23, 2022. Copies of the recorded instruments are kept in the parcel file.
table: Owner: Clearwater Land LLC. Acreage of record: {{acreage}} acres
Statutory warranty deed, Vol. M05, Page 41206 (recorded 2005), Records of Klamath County
Grantee: Clearwater Land LLC (conveys this parcel and Owner's adjoining land)
Vol. M94, Page 18832 (recorded 1994), Records of Klamath County
Covers the parcel and Owner's adjoining land. No release located of record

exhibits.title: Tab 4 — Field Notes: Site Walk, Clearwater Parcels (Route 97)
text: Alder Point Partners, Land Acquisition. Prepared by T. Reyes. Site walk on March 22, 2022, beginning 2:00 p.m. at the north gate, with Owner's managing member (Gordon L. Pruitt). Parcel references were added when the files were opened.
table: Mostly open ground with frontage on the county road. Appears to fit the siting criteria.
Access is off the county road, then an existing ranch track that appears to cross Owner's land to the north. Access rights need to be confirmed.
Owner reports an old grazing lease over both parcels, which he believes has lapsed. He has not found a release and thinks the county would have it.
Owner's figure comes from an old listing sheet and was not used. Acreage to be taken from the county record.
The recorder's office had closed (4 p.m.). County filings to be requested March 23 through Cascade Land Records (H. Cole); N. Alvarez to get parcel numbers from Owner.
Wants an option drafted quickly and asked when the first payment would come. Told him: standard terms, and nothing moves until the filings have been reviewed.
